dedupe_keys.name: autodesk tandem building digital twins from bim

description: Autodesk Tandem is a cloud service for creating digital twins of buildings: facility data are connected to a digital replica in the context of an accurate BIM model, so that owners can see how the building performs and where it could be optimised. It has two groups of features: Twin Building tools, with an interface similar to other Autodesk software and templates for making data-rich replicas, and Insightful Operations, which shows facility performance and insights once the twin is connected to the real building systems. Related products are Tandem Connect, for linking live data, and Tandem Insights. Customer stories on the site cover heritage restoration by Quinn Evans, digital twin handover by Windover Construction and a pilot at Metro Istanbul stations that the operator plans to scale to all stations. Coverage: generic; any facility modelled by the user. Access: free sign-up with a pricing page, help and tutorials, events and developer resources. Licence: commercial. Caveats: the pricing page refused automated access, so plan limits were not read; twins depend on the quality of the handed-over BIM model. Simulation uses: operational digital twins of buildings and stations for asset management and energy optimisation. Related records: Bentley iTwin, Azure Digital Twins, IFC and ArcGIS Indoors.
